entities.name: Georg Carabelli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Georg Carabelli, Edler von Lunkaszprie was a prominent Hungarian dentist and professor of dental surgery in Vienna. He held a minor noble rank, which referenced the town
of Lunkaszprie.
